findings.affected_requirement: FR-051 and the task-set ownership rule
findings.evidence: T033 and T034 both modify tests/Vulgata.Tests/PreparedChatIntegrationTests.cs and tests/Vulgata.Tests/ChatPipelineCompositionTests.cs, yet T034 is marked [P] and the parallel-opportunities section explicitly authorizes both tasks concurrently. This creates a direct shared-file ownership collision in the architecture-adoption gate.
findings.correction_outcome: Make T033 and T034 sequential under one named test owner, or divide their file ownership so no paths overlap. Remove the inaccurate [P] marker and parallel-opportunity statement unless the paths become genuinely disjoint.

findings.location: lines 120, 126, 146 and 148; compared with plan.md lines 372 and 393-400
findings.evidence: The accepted plan requires the coordinator to construct a proposed immutable Conversation State before publication and forbids only mutation or activation of live accepted state. T025, T034 and T036 instead broadly forbid a direct conversation append, while T028 requires preparation of the proposed next Conversation State. A structural test following the task text can reject the candidate-only append or construction that AD-7C requires, or let implementers interpret the guard inconsistently.
findings.correction_outcome: Define the forbidden operation precisely as activation or replacement of live current Conversation State outside AcceptedPublicationCommit. Explicitly permit immutable candidate-only AppendValidatedTurn or proposed-state construction before the critical section, and require follow-up reads to obtain conversation authority from the committed composite record.

findings.location: lines 396-414; compared with lines 248-279 and plan.md lines 370-400
findings.evidence: The relationship overview still shows validated GroundedAnswer plus ChatStreamCompletionSummary flowing directly to ValidatedRevealState and then appending ValidatedConversationTurn. That bypasses the required PreparedChatPublicationCandidate, IPreparedChatPublicationOwner and AcceptedPublicationCommit topology and depicts answer, summary, reveal and conversation as sequential effects.
findings.correction_outcome: Replace the overview tail with candidate preparation followed by the single AcceptedPublicationCommit, then read-only projections to accepted answer and reveal, committed Conversation State and completion summary. Remove the sequential post-reveal append.

summary: REVISE. The definition covers all 60 functional requirements and 17 success criteria across 53 mapped tasks, with no missing requirement, unmapped task, placeholder, Constitution violation, authority conflict, dishonest existing-evidence classification, persistence change or Story 12.4 incompatibility. Three JSON contracts parse successfully. Focused evidence produced 281 passing tests; two additional tests were blocked only by sandbox denial of the default ASP.NET DataProtection key directory. Acceptance is blocked by the explicit T033/T034 shared-file parallel collision and the ambiguous live-versus-proposed Conversation State mutation guard. The data-model overview also retains the pre-AD-7C sequential topology. Conditional implementation approval cannot activate for this artifact hash.
